items.title: Neon Sentries
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: Guard the galaxy with these Neon Sentries! Your glow will surely deter invaders and protect your world. Help keep the peace in this stylish outfit, perfect in battle or on patrol!

items.title: Geometric Friends
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description:
Check out these friendly and super trendy skins! These eye-catching skins give off a robotic and electric look. Choose from 10 skins and show off your favorite!
-1 Free

items.title: Mob High
items.creator: Asiago Bagels
items.description:
Class is in session! Pick your favourite outfit for your favourite mob, and get to learning!

+10 Mob skins!

items.title: Snowman Sweaters
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Bring your favorite snowy creatures to life with these trendy snowman-themed skins! Be the most stylish player this winter!

+ 12 skins to choose from!

items.title: Puffy Vests
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Stay warm in the cooler weather by sporting these puffy jackets and vests! Look stylish and comfortable while playing your favorite game.

+ 12 skins to choose from!

items.title: Golden Mansion
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Live the rich life in this valuable modern mansion, filled with gold!

- Great for roleplay, or just as a survival spawn
- Includes plenty of shulker boxes filled with gold.

items.title: Magical Berry Forest
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
You'll have a wild time in this spawn if you free your mind from the poisonous berries. Explore the whole Magical Berry Forest with a group of pals and make it your own!

* Magical forest! 
* 2 berry skins Included!
* Great multiplayer map!

items.title: Hackers Club
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Programming is everyone's new favorite hobby! Do you have the skills and logic to join the Hackers Club? Here everyone loves to stay on the computer all day long. You can even play some games when the leader isn't looking! Shh!

+ 1 free skin
+ 16 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Candy Lovers
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
The sweet taste of candy is driving everyone in town crazy! This night will be unforgettable, don't forget to bring the bags with you! Knock on each door in the city and fill your pockets and purses with candy. So, don't miss this chance to greet your neighbors and hopefully they will prize you!

+ 1 free skin
+ 16 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Prison Escape
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Have you ever imagined what it's like being in a high-security prison? Plan your breakout, beat various challenges, and overcome the prison's security system. Do you have what it takes to break out of the world's safest prison?

+ 2 skins 
+ Story and gameplay
+ Challenging riddles to complete

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Gaming Teens
items.creator: DogHouse
items.description:
Set a trend with these stylish skins.
There is something for everybody!

-12 skins
-Perfect for roleplay
-Enjoy!

items.title: Farm Mansion
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Farm Mansion lets you become a millionaire farmer! Enjoy driving working tractors, explore expand the massive farmlands and decorate your new mansion!

+ Great for roleplay or survival
+ Single player and multiplayer
+ Drive tractor vehicles

items.title: Emerald Tools
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Emerald Tools are here! Craft your favorite emerald weapons and tools for a great roleplay survival experience!

+ Includes a castle and village you can customize

*All tools are cosmetic items only. They won't hold any special abilities. This world is for roleplay*

items.title: Rainbow Ore Roleplay!
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
More ore!
Welcome to Rainbow Ore Roleplay where you can create fun experiences with new custom craftable rainbow weapons, tools, and armor!

*All tools and ore are cosmetic items only. The rainbow ore tools won't hold any special abilities. This world is for roleplay*

items.title: DREAM DEMONS
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
It's DREAM DEMONS!
Bright, colorful, but dangerous!

items.title: Christmas Gear
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Make this Christmas special!
Choose any of these cute Christmas themed skins!

items.title: Pet City
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
A city filled with adorable pets! Roleplay as a cute pet in the big city. This is a perfect skin pack for animal lovers!

- 8 pet skins

items.title: Pink Teen Demons
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description: What could be cuter than teen demons you ask? Pink teen demons! They are so pretty and colorful! Try on one of these beautiful skins today!

items.title: Merms
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description: Come out and play with the merms! These fun-loving ocean-dwelling creatures are out for a good time. Even the king is getting his party on. After all who else is gonna show his subjects how to really party?

items.title: 90s Teens
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
The nineties are always in fashion! Why don't you try it yourself? Choose the skin and light up the city! Be the top star.

+ Fashion
+ Teen
+ 90s
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Cyber Hunters 2
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
In the dark cyberpunk future these bounty hunters are well-known throughout the city. Grab them all and change mercenaries during gameplay. Play with friends and bring futuristic professionals to the game!

+ Cyberpunk
+ Sci Fi
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Cute Trend Foxes
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
Come and have fun with your amazing fox friends and have great adventures together with them!

- 12 Skins
- 1 Free Skin
- By UnderBlocks

items.title: Pure Ores
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Ever wanted to dress up as the very stones, jewels, and metals you mine all day and night? Well, now you can live the life of a walking, talking ore creation! Disclaimer: We are not responsible for other players trying to mine you.

- Includes 8 ore skins
- Choose from diamond, emerald, redstone, and more!
- By SmartPixel & Pathway Studios

items.title: Mobs as Teens
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Let's show up and represent our favorite mobs with this skin pack of teens sporting all sorts of outfits that would make any spider, pig, or Enderman blush. With a variety of options, who would you show some love to?
- Includes 15 colorfully unique skins
- Each skin showcases different styles and accessories
- By PixelPoly Digital & Pathway Studios
